run.covariance_rule: Gamma(t)=M(t) Gamma_parent M(t)^T, retaining all cross correlations.
run.noise_rule: N(t,s)=P_q M(t) Gamma_parent M(s)^T P_q^T; incoming covariance remains an input.
run.response_normalization: Unit canonical momentum-density impulse in normalized source harmonic Y1 or Y2. Reference norms use the two vacuum masses; they are not physical energy-conversion fractions.
run.retarded_rule: For Hamiltonian force -F q, G_R(t,s)=theta(t-s) P_q M(t) M(s)^(-1) P_p^T.
run.scope: Finite canonical Gaussian matter probe on the supplied nonlinear background; no metric fluctuations, quantum backreaction, continuum state or SI scale is selected.

normalization: Unit canonical momentum-density kicks in reference-orthonormal inherited harmonics. Vacuum-mass-weighted reference norms omit gradient, metric and interaction energy and are not conversion fractions.
qualification: Adjacent finite-band and time changes are empirical controls, not certified error bounds. Decoupled operators are diagnostic controls on the same background.

schur_memory.rule: K(t,s)=D_xy(t) U_y(t,s) D_yx(s), with U_y from the decoupled control, not a subblock of the coupled evolution.
schur_memory.scope: Chart-time canonical memory diagnostic for the finite inherited harmonic sector. It is not vacuum stress, Lambda, a physical energy fraction or a selected covariance/noise/entropy.

scope: State-independent finite Gaussian matter response on the evolving classical parent. Background geodesic held fixed; no metric fluctuations, quantum backreaction, continuum microcausality, selected covariance, entropy, noise or SI scale.
